guides.summary: Turn intent into observable product outcomes and explicit assumptions.
guides.when: The goal, user journey or acceptance is unclear.

guides.summary: Inherit design language and verify meaningful interactions.
guides.when: Changing UI, UX, copy, layout or visual style.

guides.summary: Model relevant state, async transitions and module contracts.
guides.when: Changing state ownership, asynchronous behavior or multiple modules.

guides.summary: Deliver runnable vertical slices and compare migration behavior.
guides.when: A feature, refactor or migration spans substantial work.

guides.summary: Use falsifiable hypotheses and cross-check runtime evidence.
guides.when: The cause is unknown or a repair did not change the symptom.

guides.summary: Choose proportionate checks and inspect test effectiveness.
guides.when: Planning validation, assessing evidence or preparing delivery.

guides.summary: Keep task continuity and reusable knowledge small and source-backed.
guides.when: Resuming long work or maintaining project knowledge.
